'''Cannon barrels''' are the third part of the [[dwarf multicannon]] set up on top of the [[cannon base]] after placing the [[cannon stand]] and before the [[cannon furnace]]. They shoot the enemy with a barrage of [[steel cannonball]]s or [[granite cannonballs]]. It is purchased from [[Multicannon parts for sale]] for {{NoCoins|200625}} coins.
